mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO stock_command (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, source_service, command_id, action, business_effect_key, execution_attempt_id, attempt_no, previous_command_id, payload_digest, digest_version, state, settlement_digest, result_json, compensates_command_id, safe_close_id, safe_close_version, safe_close_evidence, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (UUID(), #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sourceService}, #{commandId}, #{action}, #{effectId}, #{attemptId}, #{attemptNo}, #{previousCommandId}, #{digest}, #{digestVersion}, #{state}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO stock_posting (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, source_service, command_id, business_effect_key, action, execution_attempt_id, posting_type, quantity, source_execution_id, source_document_id, ledger_manifest, result_version, original_posting_id, reversed_qty, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sourceService}, #{commandId}, #{effectId}, #{action}, #{attemptId}, #{postingType}, #{quantity}, #{sourceExecutionId}, #{sourceDocumentId}, CAST(#{manifest} AS JSON), 1, #{originalPostingId}, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO stock_posting (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, source_service, command_id, business_effect_key, action, execution_attempt_id, posting_type, quantity, source_execution_id, source_document_id, ledger_manifest, result_version, original_posting_id, reversed_qty, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sourceService}, #{commandId}, #{effectId}, #{action}, #{attemptId}, #{postingType}, #{quantity}, #{sourceExecutionId}, #{sourceDocumentId}, CAST(#{manifest} AS JSON), 1, NULL, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT IGNORE INTO execution_permit (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, source_service, permit_id, command_id, business_effect_key, execution_attempt_id, attempt_no, source_task_id, source_task_epoch, gate_epoch, action, payload_digest, quantity, actual_qty, not_executed_qty, settlement_digest, state, started_at, posted_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{permitId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sourceService}, #{permitId}, #{commandId}, #{effectId}, #{attemptId}, #{attemptNo}, #{taskId}, #{taskEpoch}, 0, #{action}, #{digest}, #{quantity}, #{actualQty}, #{notExecutedQty}, NULL, #{state}, #{startedAt}, #{postedAt}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO reconciliation_history_guard(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id) VALUES(#{guardId},#{enterpriseId},#{warehouseId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE warehouse_id=warehouse_id
mapper.select: SELECT id,closed_before FROM reconciliation_history_guard WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_cancellation_guard(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,document_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(SHA2(JSON_ARRAY(#{e},#{w},#{o}),256),#{e},#{w},#{o},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_id=document_id
mapper.select: SELECT document_id,cancellation_id FROM outbound_cancellation_guard WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND document_id=#{o} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_cancellation_guard SET cancellation_id=#{id},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND document_id=#{o} AND cancellation_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_effect f JOIN execution_permit p ON p.enterprise_id=f.enterprise_id AND p.warehouse_id=f.warehouse_id AND p.business_effect_key=f.id WHERE f.enterprise_id=#{e} AND f.warehouse_id=#{w} AND f.source_service='wms-outbound' AND f.fact_parent_id=#{o} AND f.fact_line_id=#{line} AND f.action IN ('PICK','SHIP') AND f.fact_type IN ('SUB_ACTION','SHIPMENT_PART') AND p.state IN ('STARTED','UNKNOWN'))
